rules.statement: An owner of a dominant tenement does not lose their servitude over a servient tenement by acquiring an interest in that servient tenement.
rules.supporting_quote: "The principle involved is that of the extinction of servitudes by confusio. A servitude is extinguished when the servient and dominant land meet in the same hand, but there is no such confusio unless the interest of the proprietor in both tenements is identical."
